stream: government Census language-table source census / evidence verification
purpose: Promote first-party ORGI C-17 Jharkhand table structure and exact MUNDA/MUNDARI category locators beyond file-identity-only status while withholding every numeric value until the declared workbook is acquired and verified byte-preservingly.

source.title: C-17: Population by bilingualism and trilingualism, Jharkhand - 2011
source.producer: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India

verified_structure.table_purpose_as_catalogued: For each mother tongue, the catalogue describes counts of speakers who are bilingual, further classified by two additional languages spoken.
column_families_exposed: Total speakers of languages - Language code
Total speakers of languages - Language name
Total speakers of languages - Person / Male / Female
Number of speakers speaking subsidiary languages (1st language) - Language code
Number of speakers speaking subsidiary languages (1st language) - 1st subsidiary languages
Number of speakers speaking subsidiary languages (1st language) - Person / Male / Female
Number of speakers speaking subsidiary languages (2nd language) - Language code
Number of speakers speaking subsidiary languages (2nd language) - 2nd subsidiary languages
Number of speakers speaking subsidiary languages (2nd language) - Person / Male / Female

deduplication.reason_count_neutral: This cycle strengthens an already known first-party Census work family and does not deterministically resolve any of the 73 unresolved WEB-MUN identities.

promotion.level: exact first-party catalogue + table-schema + MUNDA/MUNDARI category locator evidence

explicit_gaps: Byte-preserving acquisition of DDW-C17-2000.XLSX from the first-party ORGI endpoint
Independent cryptographic hash of the acquired workbook
Worksheet-name, dimensions, type and merged-cell inspection
Exact row/cell verification for MUNDA and MUNDARI including Person/Male/Female and subsidiary-language fields
Independent reconciliation of any promoted numeric value before release
Explicit reuse/licence determination separate from public catalogue availability
